title: relay_queue: dead-letter count loop should use .count()
description: relay_queue.rs drain_once: dead-letter file count is accumulated with mut dead_count: f64 += 1.0 in a while loop. Idiomatic Rust: use rd.next_entry() collected or a fold/count pattern, then cast to f64. The manual f64 accumulation introduces a needless mutable variable and is non-idiomatic.
